_README: Every setting the app reads. Nothing else is configurable, on purpose.
MONGO_URI is the READ-ONLY user. mv/db.py opens the client with a read preference of
secondaryPreferred and hands out a wrapper with no write surface at all - see the guard
at the top of that file. MV_MONGO_URI overrides this value, so a shared machine never
has to edit the file. Same for MV_GEMINI_KEY.
_collections_note: THE CORRECTED SOURCE MAP. Four of these replace what the mockup's DATA-CONTRACT named,
and each correction is a measurement, not a preference:
production   was ProdMvestPortal.Activity_Production (2,098,077 pre-computed lease-month
docs). Replaced by MonthlyProductionVolumes + the transform in
Production_Activity_API_Spec.md section 4. The stored copy is pure
duplication of this collection in a different shape, it is stale between
rebuilds, and the lease id IS the _id here - so one lease is a primary-key
hit, not a scan. mv/production.py implements the spec exactly.
radius       was ProdMvestPortal.Adjacent_Lease_Activity. Replaced by
GeoMapPortal.LeaseRadiusData, which keys on the same {district}_{lease} id
and carries BOTH the nearby permits and the nearby leases, at three radii,
in one document. Adjacent_Lease_Activity carried only the lease side.
probability  was Decline_data_to_web.new_well_probability - THAT COLLECTION DOES NOT
EXIST. The real fields are 'NEW WELL PROBABILITY' (0-100) and 'NEW WELL
PROBABILITY CATEGORY' on Decline_data_to_web.Data_to_web, keyed on the same
lease id. See probability_bands below for the sentinel that must be filtered.
activity     Activity_Test is the live event feed - written today, five activity types,
and it carries activity_notification (pre-written text) plus CreateTS.
Together with the derived activity_id 3 it is the canonical event vocabulary
the Postgres side never had.

_note: LOCKED to one owner. There is no picker: this app exists to show Brown Jon S's alerts, and a
dropdown of 225 other people's records is not part of the product.
MEASURED 2026-09-02 on the 2025 roll:
ownername 'Brown Jon S'  ->  3,698 rows · 225 owner numbers · 124 counties · 2,708 leases
and ownernumber is a COUNTY appraisal key, not a person: 127,650 of 420,296 numbers
(30.4%) are carried by more than one person. Number 708789 alone is seven people.
So the owner is (ownernumber AND ownername) - both, always. That resolves to the Martin
County record: 103 leases, Permian Basin, Diamondback / Birch / XTO, with real production, a
real operator transfer and real nearby permits.
scope 'record' reads that one record. scope 'name' would read all 2,708 leases under the
name - about 515 MB of production documents and several minutes, and it would merge 225
strangers' minerals into one portfolio. It is left configurable and NOT the default.
year: the roll carries 2024 and 2025. Appraised_Value MUST be filtered to one year -
summing across years stacks the same interest twice.
owner.name: Brown Jon S

_note: Anchored on the DATA's own latest month, never the wall clock. Production posts on a
lag and MonthlyProductionVolumes carries trailing months with BOE 0 and
prod_report_filed_flag 'N' - measured on 08_55109, cycles 202607 and 202608 are both
present and both zero. Anchor on max(cycle) and the app opens by announcing that a
producing Diamondback lease has stopped. Anchor on the last NON-ZERO month and it is
right. The UI prints the as-of date so nobody reads it as today.
MEASURED over Data_to_web: -1 appears on 179,231 leases and 'Undefined' on 4. It is a
NOT-MODELLED sentinel, not a probability. Rendering it as 0% would tell an owner their
acreage has no chance of a new well when the truth is that we have not modelled it.
Filtered out at source in mv/collect.py.
LIVE, not EIA. The shipped ticker.json in the redesign repo carries
'End-of-day spot settlements. Not live prices.' with lag_days 8 - so an alert headed
'Know the same day' was reporting a settlement published the week before.
These are front-month NYMEX futures, quoted intraday. change_pct is computed against
the previous DAILY CLOSE from the same series, never against meta.chartPreviousClose -
on a multi-day range that field is the close BEFORE the window, which reports a normal
day as an 8% move.
Gemini rewrites the WORDING of findings that signals have already measured. It never
decides what is true and it cannot introduce a number - mv/summarize.py checks every
numeric token in the output against the facts and falls back to measured prose on any
miss. The source line is never taken from the model.
BUDGET IS PER PLAN, which is what 'use it as per the plan' means here:
free     0 alerts reworded - measured prose only, and the footer says so
pro      the top 3 by rank
premium  all of them, plus the one-line summary at the top
One call per panel either way - the alerts go in a single batched prompt, not one
request each.
The shell is the redesign's own owner-v42.html, served with its sidebar, top header, avatar
menu and four view densities intact. These keys only tell the binder which control to drive:
setViewTier() and mvSetFunnelState() already exist in that file.
'simple' is the internal key; the rendered name is Essentials. 'Simple' reads as derogatory
about the reader and must never surface as copy.
Plans are Free / Pro / Premium. The artifact's funnel cycler carries unclaimed/claimed/
trial/lapsed/paid and has no Pro at all, so the middle of the published ladder could not be
seen. plan_state maps each plan onto the funnel state the artifact does understand.
